runs.title: Holding period: fixed holds 20/60/120 vs live exits
runs.hypothesis: A longer fixed hold of the C-65 momentum names pays more per 20 sessions than a 20-session hold (H1), and live exits beat a plain 60-session hold (H2).
runs.passRule: H1: hold-60 or hold-120 beats hold-20 per 20 sessions net of market by >=0.5pp, monthly-cluster t>2 in fit, same sign in holdout. H2: live minus hold-60 net per trade >=0.5pp, t>2 in fit, same sign in holdout. Any pass repeated at double cost.

result.summary: Fit (931 trades, entries to 2023): per-20-session excess over market 0.92% (20) / 1.04% (60) / 0.86% (120); H1 60-20 +0.12pp t 0.22, 120-20 -0.06pp t -0.11: FAIL. H2 live minus hold-60 -9.89% t -4.42: FAIL. Holdout not revealed.

runs.title: India skip days: does excluding them improve the 5-distribution-day signal?
runs.hypothesis: Excluding expiry, Muhurat and after-holiday sessions from distribution counting (B) makes the 5+ active distribution days signal separate good from bad forward Nifty 500 markets better than counting every day (A).

params.outcome: Nifty 500 forward 20 and 60 session return and worst 60-session drawdown
params.skipB: monthly F&O expiry, Muhurat sessions, session after a holiday
params.omitted: index rebalancing days and ordinary half-days

runs.passRule: B gap (signal off minus on, 60-session return) beats A gap by >=1.0pp, monthly-cluster paired t>2 in fit, same sign in holdout; A and B must differ on >=60 fit sessions, else no detectable difference.

result.summary: Fit (929 sessions to 2023): signal gap (off minus on) in 60-session Nifty 500 return A -0.06pp, B +0.34pp; B minus A +0.40pp (t 2.78) below the 1.0pp bar: FAIL. A and B differ on 63 sessions. Neither version separates good from bad forward markets. Holdout not revealed.

runs.title: Tactical tilt of asset-class weights with market performance
runs.hypothesis: Tilting the strategic asset-class weights each month toward risk sleeves in an uptrend (above 200-session average and positive 6-month return) and away from those in a downtrend, bounded by tau per profile, earns more after costs than the same strategic weights rebalanced monthly without a tilt, without a deeper drawdown.

params.sleeves: equity NIFTYBEES, international MON100 (from 2021-06-18), gold GOLDBEES, silver SILVERBEES (from 2022-05-10, folded into gold before), debt+liquid fixed 6% a year
params.strategic: allocation engine, horizon 10 years, profiles Cautious/Balanced/Aggressive, collapsed to the five sleeves (equity = direct + active + index + sector)
params.signal: close above 200-session SMA and 6-month (126-session) return above zero, at month-end close
params.tilt: weight x (1 + tau) if up, x (1 - tau) if down; tau 0.25 / 0.35 / 0.50 by profile; difference moves to or from debt; each class held inside its maximum from settings/allocation.json
params.cost: 0.30% of traded value in both arms
params.metrics: annual return after costs, maximum drawdown on daily portfolio value, calendar-year comparison, turnover

runs.passRule: Balanced, fit: tilt minus static annual return after costs >= +1.0pp; tilt max drawdown no worse than static by more than 1.0pp; tilt ahead in at least 2 of the 3 fit calendar-year periods; holdout same signs. Any pass repeated at double cost and must hold in at least 2 of 3 profiles. Result is before tax; a pass needs a tax check before any rule.

result.summary: Fit (18 Jun 2021 to 28 Mar 2024, 689 sessions): annual return after 0.30% cost, tilt minus static: Cautious -0.49pp, Balanced -0.80pp, Aggressive -2.00pp; at double cost -0.86, -1.46, -2.84pp. Balanced bar +1.0pp: FAIL; no profile meets the bars. Tilt ahead in 2 of 3 yearly blocks (+1.8pp, -7.4pp, +4.2pp for Balanced) but the middle year (Jun 2022 to Jun 2023, trend whipsaw in gold, silver and international) cost more than the other two earned. Turnover 12x the start value for tilt against 1.8x for static. Holdout not revealed.

runs.title: Sector rotation sleeve vs the Nifty 500
runs.hypothesis: Holding the top two sectors that pass the Swing Desk sector gate (3-month return beats the Nifty 500 and is above zero, close above 50-session average), ranked by 2 x 3M + 1M and rebalanced monthly, earns more after costs than holding the Nifty 500, without a materially deeper drawdown.

params.universe: 15 NSE sector price indices with history from 2020-01: Auto, Bank, Consumer Durables, Energy, FMCG, Financial Services, IT, Infrastructure, Media, Metal, Oil & Gas, PSE, PSU Bank, Pharma, Realty
params.gate: 63-session return > Nifty 500 63-session return, > 0, and close > 50-session SMA
params.rank: 2 x 63-session + 1 x 21-session return; top 2 equal weight; none qualifies = Nifty 500
params.cost: 0.30% of traded value plus 0.30% a year expense drag on the sector arm
params.metrics: annual return after costs, maximum drawdown on daily value, calendar-year comparison, turnover

runs.passRule: Fit: sector sleeve minus Nifty 500 annual return after costs >= +2.0pp; max drawdown no worse than the Nifty 500 by more than 3.0pp; ahead in at least 3 of 4 fit calendar years; holdout same signs; any pass repeated at double cost.

result.summary: Fit (1 Jan 2020 to 31 Dec 2023, 907 sessions from Apr 2020): annual return after 0.30% cost, sector sleeve 28.34% vs Nifty 500 29.32% (-0.98pp), maximum drawdown -36.7% vs -18.5% (18.2pp worse); at double cost -6.41pp. Bars (+2.0pp, drawdown within 3pp, ahead in 3 of 4 years): FAIL. Ahead in 3 of 4 years at 0.30% but 2020 lagged by 39pp; monthly turnover about 150x the start value. Holdout not revealed.

runs.title: Rebalancing cadence: monthly vs yearly vs band
runs.hypothesis: Rebalancing once a year, or only when a class leaves its drift band, earns about the same after costs as rebalancing every month, with far less trading and no deeper drawdown.

params.arms: N none; M monthly full; Y yearly full; BF band trigger, all to target; BE band trigger, to band edge
params.profiles: Cautious, Balanced, Aggressive; 10-year horizon strategic weights

runs.passRule: A candidate (Y, BF, BE) passes if in Balanced at 0.30% cost: annual return after cost no more than 0.5 points below M, turnover at most half of M, max drawdown no worse than M by more than 1.0 point, and the same at 0.60% cost, in at least 2 of 3 profiles. Lowest turnover among passers is the proposed default; holdout must show the same signs.

result.summary: Fit (18 Jun 2021 to 28 Mar 2024, 689 sessions), Balanced at 0.30% cost, annual return / worst fall / turnover as a multiple of start value: none 12.16% / -9.61% / 0; monthly 12.25% / -9.56% / 1.8x (64 trades); yearly 12.20% / -9.36% / 0.6x (5); band-all 12.16% / -9.61% / 0.6x (3); band-to-edge 12.16% / -9.61% / 0.3x (9). All three candidates meet the bars in all three profiles at both costs; lowest turnover is band-to-edge. Return differences between all arms are under 0.1 point, because the bands were rarely breached in this window. Holdout not yet revealed.

holdoutReveal.note: fit result recorded; revealing the holdout once to check the signs

runs.title: Rebalancing cadence with bands scaled to the target (second attempt)
runs.hypothesis: Rebalancing once a year, or only when a class leaves its band, earns about the same after costs as rebalancing every month, with far less trading and no deeper drawdown, when the band is never more than half of the class target (C-89 rule 10).

params.arms: N none; M monthly full; Y yearly full; BF band trigger, all to target; BE band trigger, to band edge
params.bands: smaller of the configured driftBand and half of the class target, at least 1 point (scaledBand)
params.note: Same windows as C-86-r1, whose holdout was revealed on 23 Oct 2026: this holdout is not independent of attempt 1.

runs.passRule: As C-86-r1: a candidate (Y, BF, BE) passes if in Balanced at 0.30% cost: annual return after cost no more than 0.5 points below M, turnover at most half of M, max drawdown no worse than M by more than 1.0 point, and the same at 0.60% cost, in at least 2 of 3 profiles. Lowest turnover among passers is the proposed default; holdout must show the same signs.

result.summary: Fit (18 Jun 2021 to 28 Mar 2024), bands scaled to half the class target. Balanced at 0.30% cost: none 12.16% / -9.61% / 0; monthly 12.25% / -9.56% / 1.8x (64 trades); yearly 12.20% / -9.36% / 0.6x (5); band-all 12.12% / -9.64% / 0.5x (4); band-to-edge 12.21% / -9.61% / 0.4x (17). All three candidates meet the bars in every profile at both costs; lowest turnover is band-to-edge, as in attempt 1. Holdout not independent of attempt 1 (same window, already revealed).

holdoutReveal.note: same holdout window as C-86-r1, already revealed on 23 Oct 2026; checking signs on the scaled bands

runs.title: Fund consistency measure: rolling 3-year windows vs rolling 1-year windows
runs.hypothesis: Consistency measured on rolling 3-year windows (closer to the holding horizon, less overlap-inflated) makes the Strong band beat the category median in at least 60% of years, where the 1-year measure failed Test A (5 of 10), while Weak still trails it.

params.unchanged: weights r1 0.2 r3 0.35 r5 0.3 consistency 0.15; rollingMonths 36; step 30 days; Strong >=75, Weak <25
params.bar: BT: 60% of counted years, at least 5 years, at least 10 funds a year
params.sample: same fetched NAVs and Direct-Growth plain-equity schemes as C-81, both measures in the same run
params.multipleTesting: Test A was already tried once on the 1-year measure; one variant only

runs.passRule: Adopt the 3-year measure only if Test A and Test B both pass under it by the C-81 bar. Otherwise the 1-year measure stays live. Result recorded either way.

result.summary: 3-year windows: Test A 4/10 fail, Test B 7/10 pass; not adopted. 1-year on same run: A 5/10, B 6/10.

runs.title: Risk-aware score for plain-equity funds vs FUND-3 in the C-81 back-test
runs.hypothesis: Ranking equity funds on the C-82 risk-aware score (3-year return, consistency, return per unit of volatility, worst fall) makes Strong funds beat their category median in at least 60% of years, where FUND-3 failed Test A, while Weak still trails it.

params.variant: scoreRisk with C-82 weights ret 30 cons 20 ra 20 dd 15; cost 15 absent (no past expense ratios), weights renormalise
params.unchanged: bands Strong>=75 Weak<25; bar 60% of counted years, >=5 years, >=10 funds a year; same fetched NAVs as C-81
params.multipleTesting: third score variant on Tests A and B (FUND-3, C-92 3-year consistency, this)

runs.passRule: Adopt only if Test A and Test B both pass under the risk-aware score by the C-81 bar; otherwise FUND-3 stays. Result recorded either way.

result.summary: Risk-aware score: Test A 3/10 fail, Test B 5/10 fail; not adopted. FUND-3 same run A 5/10, B 6/10.

runs.title: Index-fund bands (Leads, In line, Lags) in the C-81 back-test
runs.hypothesis: Among Direct-Growth index funds tracking the same index, funds that lead the group median over 3 years keep beating it over the next year, and funds that lag keep trailing it.

params.universe: Direct-Growth index funds (no ETFs) on Nifty 50, Nifty Midcap 150, Nifty Smallcap 250, Nifty 500
params.bar: 60% of counted years, at least 5 years, at least 5 funds in the band a year
params.years: 2015 to 2025, same fetched NAVs as C-81
params.limit: expense ratios are not available at past dates, so the cheapest-fund pick is not tested

runs.passRule: Test A (Leads beat the same-index median next year) and Test B (Lags trail it) both pass by the bar: the bands may then be shown on the Holdings tab as information. Otherwise index funds keep no band-based advice. One run, result recorded either way.

result.summary: Not testable: no year had 5 funds in the Leads or Lags band (counted 0 of 0). No conclusion; nothing changes.

runs.title: Cross-category tilt (best risk-adjusted categories) vs the fixed market mix
runs.hypothesis: Holding the two plain-equity categories with the best median 3-year return per unit of volatility beats the fixed market mix (Large 71, Mid 18, Small 11) over the next year, in most years.

params.categories: Large Cap, Large & Mid Cap, Mid Cap, Small Cap, Flexi Cap, Multi Cap, Focused, Value
params.rank: category median 3-year return divided by median 3-year volatility; at least 8 funds with a record
params.hold: top 2, equal weight, category median next-year return
params.limits: survivorship, category medians not funds, one yearly step, no tax or exit load

runs.passRule: Tilt beats the mix in at least 60% of counted years, at least 5 counted years, median yearly excess above zero, worst year no more than 3 points worse than the mix's worst year. Otherwise the cross-category table stays information only. Result recorded either way.

result.summary: Passed: tilt beat the market mix in 7 of 10 years, median excess +1.7pp, worst year -4.8 vs -3.7. Mostly extra mid/small risk; 5 of 10 vs equal weight. Not applied.

runs.title: All fund types together: cross-group tilt vs the Balanced preset and an equal-weight spread
runs.hypothesis: Choosing the top three fund groups by past return above cash per unit of volatility, from all fund types together, beats the owner's Balanced preset and an equal-weight spread over the next year.

params.universe: every Direct-Growth scheme and ETF the scoring covers: equity categories, ELSS, thematic by theme, hybrids, index groups, gold and silver, international markets, debt groups, liquid and overnight
params.min: at least 5 funds with a 3-year record per group
params.rank: (median 3y return minus liquid median 3y return) / median 3y volatility
params.hold: top 3 groups, equal weight, group median next-year return, 1 Oct 2015 to 2025
params.baselines: Balanced preset from settings/allocation.json at the middle horizon over fund classes, rescaled; equal weight of all eligible groups
params.limits: survivorship, group medians, one yearly step, no tax, exit load or past expense ratio

runs.passRule: All four: tilt beats the preset in at least 60% of counted years (at least 5 counted); median yearly excess over the preset above zero; worst year no more than 3 points worse than the preset's worst; tilt beats equal weight in at least 60% of counted years. PASS: a bounded tilt of new money may be proposed to the owner; FAIL: allocation stays the preset and no cross-group buy recommendation is made.

result.summary: FAIL: beat preset 6/10, median +1.5pp, beat equal weight 6/10, but worst year -6.8% vs preset worst -0.3% (limit 3 points). 22 of 30 picks debt groups. Allocation unchanged; no cross-group buy recommendation.

runs.title: Holdings health: forward record of the stock-trend reading against the fund's next-year return
runs.hypothesis: Funds whose held stocks are mostly above their 200-session average and rising (Strong band) beat their category median over the next 12 months; Weak band funds trail it.

params.bands: percentile in category of aboveShare and ret6m, Strong from 75, Weak below 25
params.limits: no back-test possible, only portfolios from 30 Sep 2026 on

runs.passRule: Test A and B: at least 60% of counted snapshot months pass, at least 6 counted months, a month counts with at least 10 funds in the band. Not used as a recommendation until both pass.

runs.title: Thematic funds scored against their own theme: Tests A and B
runs.hypothesis: Within a theme, FUND-3 Strong funds beat the theme median over the next year and Weak funds trail it.

params.universe: Direct-Growth Sectoral/Thematic schemes alive today whose name gives a theme
params.min: 5 funds with a 3-year record per theme
params.outcome: forward 12-month return minus own-theme median, Strong and Weak pooled across themes
params.limits: survivorship, theme from the name, mandate changes, no past expense ratio or exit load

runs.passRule: Test A and Test B each: at least 60% of counted years pass, at least 5 counted years, a year counts with at least 10 funds in the pooled band. Use per C-102.

result.summary: NOT TESTABLE: own-theme bands hold 3 to 9 Strong and 3 to 8 Weak funds a year, never the 10 needed; 0 counted years. Informational: Strong beat the theme median in 4 of 9 years, Weak trailed in 5 of 9. No band shown for thematic funds.

runs.title: International funds with the C-82 score: Tests A and B
runs.hypothesis: Within a holding group, C-82 Strong international funds beat the group median over the next year and Weak funds trail it.

params.universe: Direct-Growth international funds of funds alive today
params.min: 3 funds with a 3-year record per group
params.outcome: forward 12-month return minus own-group median, Strong and Weak pooled across groups
params.limits: survivorship, theme from the name, mandate changes, no past expense ratio or exit load

runs.passRule: Test A and Test B each: at least 60% of counted years pass, at least 5 counted years, a year counts with at least 5 funds in the pooled band. Use per C-103.

result.summary: NOT TESTABLE: no year with 5 Strong funds, only 2025 with 5 Weak. Informational: Strong beat group median 3 of 9 years, Weak trailed only 2 of 10. International band labelled not shown to predict.

runs.title: Holdings health proxy back-test: today's portfolios applied to nine past dates
runs.hypothesis: Funds whose held stocks were mostly above their 200-session average and rising at a past date (Strong band) beat their category median over the next 12 months; Weak band funds trailed it; rank correlation positive.

params.portfolio: 30 Sep 2026 (biased in favour of the score)
params.outcome: next-12-month NAV return minus category median of covered funds
params.limits: nine dates are about three independent years; funds alive today; closes unadjusted except unreadable-stock guard

runs.passRule: A, B and C each pass in at least 60% of counted dates (at least 6) and mean Spearman correlation above zero = not rejected; anything else = fail. A pass proves nothing.

result.summary: FAIL with bias in the score's favour: A 5/9, B 5/9, C 5/9 (needs 6), mean rank correlation -0.002. Stays an information line.

runs.title: Thematic and international scores: yearly rank correlation with next-year excess return
runs.hypothesis: A higher score inside the group goes with a better next-12-month return than the group median, in most years.

params.universe: thematic by own theme (FUND-3, 5 peers), international (C-82 score, no cost, 3 peers), plain equity as yardstick
params.statistic: Spearman between score and forward excess over group median, funds pooled
params.limits: survivorship, theme from the name, second look after C-102 and C-103 descriptives were seen

runs.passRule: Correlation above zero in at least 60% of counted years (a year counts with at least 10 scored funds), at least 5 counted years, mean correlation above zero.

result.summary: Thematic PASS (7/10 years positive, mean +0.06; plain equity yardstick also passes 7/10, +0.05). International FAIL (3/9 years, mean -0.14). Thematic gets Watch for Weak in own theme; international note stays.

runs.title: Stock-trend signal on its own: 50-session over 200-session average vs forward 3, 6 and 12 month stock returns
runs.hypothesis: Stocks with the 50-session average above the 200-session average beat the others over the next 12 months.

params.limits: survivorship, unadjusted closes outside the guard, overlapping dates, one regime

runs.passRule: At 12 months: at least 60% of counted dates pass, at least 6 counted dates, mean difference above zero. Registered in the manifest after the single run (rule text in the change log first).

result.summary: FAIL at 12 months: 6 of 12 counted dates (50%), mean +3.6 points carried by two 2023 dates. Passes at 6 months (10/14). Trend signal not a basis for choosing funds; 200-session rule stays an exit rule.

runs.title: Swing trend rules on mutual fund NAVs: trend template and Exit state vs forward group-relative returns
runs.hypothesis: Funds passing the stock trend template on their NAV beat their group median over the next 12 months; funds in Keep state beat funds in Exit state over 6 months.

params.universe: Direct-Growth plain equity (own category) and thematic (own theme), alive today
params.outcome: forward 3/6/12 month return minus group median
params.limits: survivorship, overlapping dates (about ten independent years at 12 months)

runs.passRule: Test 1 at 12 months and Test 2 at 6 months: at least 60% of counted dates pass, at least 20 counted dates, mean above zero, 1 October dates positive in at least 6 of 10 years.

result.summary: Both failed. Template on NAV: 6 of 19 counted dates (needs 20 dates, 60%). Keep vs Exit at 6 months: thematic 6 of 12, equity 8 of 17. Mean gaps 0.1 to 0.6 points. Template not used; thematic label reworded as a trend flag. Information only: top third by 126-session return beat group on 25/40 dates at 12m (+0.43 points).

runs.title: Frozen desk rules on India 2011-2019: (a) C-54 momentum baseline, (b) C-64 desk setups
runs.hypothesis: The rules tuned on 2021-2026 also work on 2010-2019 data they have never seen.

params.regimeIndex: Nifty 500 from 2012-02-21, BSE 500 scaled before and on missing sessions (99.4% flag agreement)
params.survivorship: (a) delisted included; (b) today's industry map, labelled survivor-biased

runs.passRule: (a) as C-54: mean excess over the equal-weight eligible list above zero with 90% block-bootstrap lower bound above zero, above zero after dropping the best three months, above zero in at least 6 of 9 calendar years. (b) as C-64: mean excess over the equal-weight market above zero with 90% lower bound above zero, above zero after dropping the best group, above zero in at least 6 of 9 calendar years.

result.summary: Both frozen rules FAIL on India 2011-2019. (a) momentum: mean excess +0.35%/month, 90% interval -0.21% to +0.92%, +0.12% after dropping best 3 months, 5 of 9 years positive: fails interval and years. (b) desk setups: 35 valid trades, mean excess -0.14%, interval -1.8% to +1.6%, -1.0% after dropping best group, 3 of 8 years positive: fails all four.

runs.title: US rules on 2018-2025 (survivor-biased): (a) momentum baseline copy, (b) frozen US-SCAN-1 top-10 list
runs.hypothesis: The rules the desk runs on US stocks also work on eight years of data no earlier US test used.

params.survivorship: SURVIVOR-BIASED UPWARD: store holds only stocks liquid and trading today

runs.passRule: For each: mean excess above zero with the lower end of the 90% block-bootstrap interval above zero; above zero after dropping the best three months (a) or best industry group (b); above zero in at least 5 of 8 calendar-year buckets.

result.summary: (a) US momentum copy passes all four conditions (mean excess +1.04%/month, interval +0.22% to +1.91%, 7 of 8 years) but trails SPY held throughout (+131% vs +147%) and is survivor-biased. (b) frozen US-SCAN-1 top-10 list fails the interval condition (mean excess +0.48% per 20 sessions, interval -0.28% to +1.33%).
